mechanisms.name: EngineCore busy loop
mechanisms.trigger: EngineCoreProc.run_busy_loop from process start until shutdown completes
mechanisms.observable: the process blocks on input_queue while idle; with work it drains every queued client message, steps the engine, and queues outputs, repeating until _handle_shutdown returns false

mechanisms.name: Engine step: schedule, execute, sample, update
mechanisms.trigger: each busy-loop pass with requests, when the batch queue is off
mechanisms.observable: a batch runs on the workers, aborts that arrived during the forward pass apply, and update_from_output yields per-client EngineCoreOutputs stamped with the weight version

mechanisms.name: Request status and finish-reason lifecycle
mechanisms.trigger: the scheduler moving a Request between waiting, running, preempted and finished statuses
mechanisms.observable: RequestStatus values past PREEMPTED count as finished and map to stop, length, abort, error or repetition finish reasons on the output

mechanisms.name: Engine startup handshake
mechanisms.trigger: MPClient construction, launch_core_engines and each EngineCoreProc start
mechanisms.observable: HELLO gets the init message with addresses, the engine builds, sends READY plus a parallel_config hash under DP; a wrong locality, headless flag, hash or state raises, and a dead process fails startup

mechanisms.name: KV sizing and warm-up at engine init
mechanisms.trigger: EngineCore.__init__ after the executor loads the model
mechanisms.observable: worker specs and profiled memory decide num_gpu_blocks, workers allocate the pool, the model warms up, then the scheduler is built
mechanisms.note: missing: non-causal layers disabling chunked prefill and prefix caching, resolve_kv_cache_layout, the update_max_model_len sync after auto-fit (gpu-worker-impl.update-max-model-len has no caller), measure_encoder_output_widths

mechanisms.name: Ready response and front-end config sync
mechanisms.trigger: MPClient polling the input socket after launch, bounded by VLLM_ENGINE_READY_TIMEOUT_S
mechanisms.observable: each engine sends EngineCoreReadyResponse; the front-end takes the minimum max_model_len, sums num_gpu_blocks, adopts block sizes; silence raises TimeoutError

mechanisms.name: Input socket thread
mechanisms.trigger: each message on an engine input socket
mechanisms.observable: the thread decodes and preprocesses an ADD outside the forward pass, sends a preprocessing error as an ERROR output for that request alone, routes FT commands to the sentinel, and queues the rest

mechanisms.name: Output socket thread
mechanisms.trigger: each item on the engine output_queue
mechanisms.observable: outputs are encoded and sent to the owning client index, or to the coordinator for index -1; ENGINE_CORE_DEAD goes to every client and ends the thread; payload buffers are reused once zmq finishes
mechanisms.note: the send goes to the client kind; the client_index socket choice, coordinator index -1 route and tracked buffer reuse are not modeled

mechanisms.name: Abort propagation through both engine queues
mechanisms.trigger: client disconnect, AsyncLLM.abort, or LLMEngine.abort_request
mechanisms.observable: the stream gets a final ABORT output, external and parent ids expand to internal ids, ABORT reaches the engine on aborts_queue and input_queue, and stale aborts are dropped when idle

mechanisms.name: AsyncLLM output handler loop
mechanisms.trigger: a background task started by the first add_request or eagerly inside an event loop
mechanisms.observable: it pulls EngineCoreOutputs, processes them in chunks, invalidates drifted multimodal hashes, aborts stop-string finishes in the engine and records stats; an exception goes to every request collector
mechanisms.note: one pass per call; the VLLM_V1_OUTPUT_PROC_CHUNK_SIZE split and asyncio.sleep(0) yield between chunks are named but do not run

mechanisms.name: Per-request output processing
mechanisms.trigger: OutputProcessor.process_outputs over each batch of EngineCoreOutput
mechanisms.observable: outputs for aborted ids are skipped; stats update, tokens detokenize, stop strings finish and trim surplus tokens, RequestOutputs reach the collector or return list, and finished state is freed
mechanisms.note: missing: weight version spans (track_weight_version), LoRA state updates, tracing; stream_interval and streaming input are listed separately

mechanisms.name: Stream interval token batching
mechanisms.trigger: make_request_output on each step when stream_interval is above 1
mechanisms.observable: a stream sends the first token, then one output per interval tokens with the accumulated delta, and always the final output
mechanisms.note: stream_interval reaches sampling params but no output-processor behavior reads it

mechanisms.name: Per-request output collector merging
mechanisms.trigger: the output handler putting outputs for a consumer that has not read yet
mechanisms.observable: delta outputs merge into the pending one instead of queueing, an exception replaces what is pending and is raised at get

mechanisms.name: Detokenizer stop finish aborts the engine
mechanisms.trigger: a stop string matching in the front-end while the engine still runs the request
mechanisms.observable: finish_reason becomes stop, tokens past the match are dropped, and an ABORT goes to the engine so its slots free

mechanisms.name: Incremental detokenization
mechanisms.trigger: each new token for a request with a detokenizer
mechanisms.observable: text extends a token at a time, the stop token is held back unless include_stop_str_in_output, and min_tokens delays the stop search
mechanisms.note: the fast and slow decoder dispatch and the _protected_step recovery from tokenizer errors are not modeled; one decode rule stands in

mechanisms.name: Logprobs assembly
mechanisms.trigger: EngineCoreOutput carrying sample or prompt logprob tensors
mechanisms.observable: sample logprobs and the cumulative logprob extend, prompt logprobs pop once, and each entry carries a decoded token
mechanisms.note: _correct_decoded_token, which rewrites replacement characters from neighboring tokens, is not modeled

mechanisms.name: Parallel sampling fan-out and merge
mechanisms.trigger: a sampling request with n above 1
mechanisms.observable: n children run with ids <idx>_<parent> and seed+index, admission counts n slots, a non-streaming parent returns one output once all children finish

mechanisms.name: Request validation into EngineCoreRequest
mechanisms.trigger: add_request with a prompt and params
mechanisms.observable: params, LoRA, DP rank and prompt length against max_model_len are checked in order, a failure raises VLLMValidationError, and a success builds the EngineCoreRequest with a suffixed internal id

mechanisms.name: Queue admission control
mechanisms.trigger: each new request or parent request in AsyncLLM
mechanisms.observable: over max_num_queued_reqs or at max_num_queued_tokens the request fails with HTTP 503 and a rejection counter increments

mechanisms.name: Shared admission counters across API servers
mechanisms.trigger: OutputProcessor state changes in each API server process
mechanisms.observable: each process writes its unfinished count to its own cache-line slot and readers sum the slots, so max_num_queued_reqs holds globally

mechanisms.name: Engine process liveness monitor
mechanisms.trigger: the MPClientEngineMonitor thread, polling process sentinels with a 1 s timeout
mechanisms.observable: when an engine dies outside shutdown the client marks engine_dead and shuts down, and later calls raise EngineDeadError

mechanisms.name: Worker process liveness monitor
mechanisms.trigger: the MultiprocWorkerMonitor thread, blocked on worker sentinels
mechanisms.observable: a worker death outside shutdown marks the executor failed, shuts it down and puts EXECUTOR_FAILED on the input queue, raising in the busy loop

mechanisms.name: Engine death reaching every request
mechanisms.trigger: a fatal busy-loop exception, or the client finding a dead engine
mechanisms.observable: ENGINE_CORE_DEAD goes out within a 5 s join, validate_alive raises EngineDeadError, every collector receives it, and add_request refuses afterwards

mechanisms.name: Engine graceful shutdown
mechanisms.trigger: SIGTERM or SIGINT in the engine process
mechanisms.observable: RUNNING goes to REQUESTED then SHUTTING_DOWN; shutdown_timeout 0 aborts in-flight requests, otherwise they drain; new ADD and UTILITY are refused; the loop exits when no work remains

mechanisms.name: Engine process termination ladder
mechanisms.trigger: CoreEngineProcManager.shutdown, or its weakref finalizer
mechanisms.observable: each live process gets SIGTERM, waits within the timeout (5 s when unset), and survivors have their process tree killed; ROCm gets a longer grace after an immediate abort
mechanisms.note: the ROCm grace override is not modeled

mechanisms.name: Worker termination and parent-death exit
mechanisms.trigger: MultiprocExecutor.shutdown, or the parent process exiting
mechanisms.observable: closing death pipes asks workers to exit; after VLLM_WORKER_SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT_SECONDS they get SIGTERM, then SIGKILL 4 s later; a worker whose parent dies shuts its queues via EOF on the pipe
mechanisms.note: the shutdown path is modeled; a worker reacting to its parent dying (death_pipe_monitor) never runs

mechanisms.name: Fault-tolerant busy loop and sentinel recovery
mechanisms.trigger: an exception in the busy loop with enable_fault_tolerance
mechanisms.observable: requests abort, batches clear, status goes UNHEALTHY or DEAD and is pushed; the loop waits engine_recovery_timeout_sec for a retry command, then resumes or re-raises
mechanisms.note: _reinit_dp_group, which rebuilds the DP process group on new ports during retry, is not modeled

mechanisms.name: Engine utility call round trip
mechanisms.trigger: any client call_utility, such as sleep, reset or collective_rpc
mechanisms.observable: a call id maps to a future; the engine looks the method up lazily, returns the result or a failure_message, defers replies for Future results, and consensus calls raise when engines disagree

mechanisms.name: Worker collective RPC over shared-memory queues
mechanisms.trigger: each execute_model, sample_tokens or collective_rpc on MultiprocExecutor
mechanisms.observable: the call broadcasts to all ranks; replies come from one output rank or all, a FAILURE reply raises RuntimeError, a missed deadline raises TimeoutError, and non-blocking calls resolve in FIFO order
mechanisms.note: the FutureWrapper queue that drains earlier replies first (FIFO across in-flight batches) is not modeled

mechanisms.name: Worker async output copy thread
mechanisms.trigger: a worker RPC output when async_scheduling is on
mechanisms.observable: outputs go through a queue to a dedicated thread on the worker device that resolves AsyncModelRunnerOutput and sends it, so the worker returns to the next RPC
mechanisms.note: the item is handled inline; no separate thread overlaps the next RPC

mechanisms.name: Multiproc worker startup
mechanisms.trigger: MultiprocExecutor._init_executor
mechanisms.observable: one process per local rank inits its device and loads the model, signals READY over a pipe with queue handles, then both sides wait for queues in a fixed order
mechanisms.note: one parallel join stands in; ready pipes, inherited fd closing, and the ordered wait_until_ready are not modeled

mechanisms.name: Batch queue overlap step
mechanisms.trigger: busy-loop pass when max_concurrent_batches is above 1 (pipeline parallelism or async scheduling)
mechanisms.observable: a new batch launches while the queue has room with no output; a full or idle queue blocks on the oldest; sampling is deferred for structured output waiting on prior tokens
mechanisms.note: the draft-token check for a deferred request (take_draft_token_ids then update_draft_token_ids_in_output) is not modeled

mechanisms.name: Executor backend selection
mechanisms.trigger: Executor.get_class at engine creation
mechanisms.observable: distributed_executor_backend selects ray (v1 or v2 by env), mp, uni, external_launcher, or a qualified class name; a non-Executor type raises

mechanisms.name: In-process and externally launched execution
mechanisms.trigger: backend uni or external_launcher
mechanisms.observable: one worker runs in the engine process; non-blocking execution surfaces failures early; an external launcher reads its rank and world from its environment

mechanisms.name: Ray compiled DAG execution
mechanisms.trigger: execute_model and sample_tokens on RayDistributedExecutor
mechanisms.observable: execute_model defers to sample_tokens, the first use compiles a DAG over the workers, and a future or the aggregated output returns
mechanisms.note: executor.execute-model routes only to mp, external_launcher and uni

mechanisms.name: Ray cluster and placement group setup
mechanisms.trigger: initialize_ray_cluster, and DP placement in CoreEngineActorManager
mechanisms.observable: bundles are checked per device, a placement group is created and waited for, and missing GPUs raise an error after PG_WAIT_TIMEOUT
mechanisms.note: the wait loop with doubling warnings and the timeout errors are not modeled; ray-cluster.placement-group has no behavior

mechanisms.name: Ray V2 worker monitor
mechanisms.trigger: the RayWorkerMonitor thread, ray.wait every 5 s
mechanisms.observable: a finished worker run ref fails the executor, shuts it down and fires the failure callback; shutdown joins the monitor before Ray teardown

mechanisms.name: Ray engine actor management
mechanisms.trigger: data_parallel_backend ray
mechanisms.observable: engine actors start in placement groups, ray.wait polls run refs every 5 s, a RayActorError records the failure and triggers shutdown, and shutdown kills actors and removes groups

mechanisms.name: Ray V2 executor startup
mechanisms.trigger: RayExecutorV2._init_executor
mechanisms.observable: worker actors start in placement bundles, report handles and connect queues like MultiprocExecutor

mechanisms.name: DP wave lockstep with dummy batches
mechanisms.trigger: run_busy_loop on each MoE data-parallel rank
mechanisms.observable: ranks without work run dummy batches, an all-reduce on step 1 and every dp_sync_interval steps decides whether anyone has work, and rank 0 reports wave_complete so the wave increments

mechanisms.name: DP first-request wave wake
mechanisms.trigger: a request sent while DP engines are paused, or a stale-wave request reaching an engine
mechanisms.observable: the client tells the coordinator, which broadcasts START_DP_WAVE excluding the chosen engine; a stale wave notifies via start_wave so all ranks resume
mechanisms.note: the stale-wave path in DPEngineCoreProc.add_request does not run: no behavior sends start_wave from an add

mechanisms.name: DP two-phase pause consensus
mechanisms.trigger: pause_scheduler on a DP rank
mechanisms.observable: pending_pause keeps ranks stepping until an all-reduce confirms all are pausing; then stale START_DP_WAVE messages are ignored and resume waits on a barrier
mechanisms.note: only the ignore check exists; nothing sets pending_pause, reaches consensus, or runs the resume barrier

mechanisms.name: DP prefill cadence throttle
mechanisms.trigger: each DP step with prefill_schedule_interval above 1
mechanisms.observable: new prefills are deferred except on steps divisible by the interval, aligned across ranks by the lockstep counter
mechanisms.note: the base False path runs; DPEngineCoreProc._should_throttle_prefills has no behavior

mechanisms.name: DP engine selection for a request
mechanisms.trigger: DPLBAsyncMPClient.add_request_async
mechanisms.observable: a session keeps its engine, data_parallel_rank wins, otherwise the lowest score of max(clients*inflight, waiting+running) plus a KV-pressure penalty wins, with a rotating tie break; aborts follow the chosen engine
mechanisms.note: the late-interaction routing that pins pooling requests to an engine is not modeled

mechanisms.name: DP load stats publication
mechanisms.trigger: engine request counts changing, and the coordinator poll timeout
mechanisms.observable: engines publish waiting, running and KV usage when changed; the coordinator publishes every 100 ms when changed or 5 s otherwise, snapshotted at step boundaries; clients keep the latest
mechanisms.note: stats updates apply, but the engine publisher, publish timer and step-boundary snapshot do not run

mechanisms.name: DP coordinator process startup
mechanisms.trigger: launch_core_engines for an online DP run needing a coordinator
mechanisms.observable: the process reports bound addresses over a pipe within 120 s, waits for every engine subscription, then sends READY; engines finish their handshake only after it

mechanisms.name: Elastic EP scale prepare and commit
mechanisms.trigger: AsyncLLM.scale_elastic_ep
mechanisms.observable: prepare validates the size and starts new engines or reconfigures survivors; commit pauses, switches, waits for ready and notifications, updates the coordinator and resumes
mechanisms.note: prepare checks the bounds, but commit only sets the engine count: no reconfig call, pause, new engine, wait or coordinator notification runs

mechanisms.name: Elastic EP reconfiguration inside the engine
mechanisms.trigger: reinitialize_distributed and commit_prepared_elastic_ep utility calls
mechanisms.observable: the busy loop advances an ElasticEPScalingState, switches parallel setup at commit, a removed rank exits, and notifications reach the client

mechanisms.name: Scheduler pause and resume
mechanisms.trigger: AsyncLLM.pause_generation and resume_generation
mechanisms.observable: abort, wait or keep sets the pause state; the Future completes on idle after a device sync and optional cache clear; resume unpauses

mechanisms.name: Engine sleep and wake
mechanisms.trigger: sleep and wake_up on the engine, with enable_sleep_mode
mechanisms.observable: level 0 only pauses, level 1 and 2 also release memory through the workers; tags track what sleeps; scheduling resumes only when all memory is resident again

mechanisms.name: Live weight update and version tracking
mechanisms.trigger: the start, update and finish weight-update calls from a trainer
mechanisms.observable: weights change on every worker, a new version goes to the engine, and each output batch carries it
mechanisms.note: per-request version spans in RequestState (track_weight_version) are not modeled

mechanisms.name: Prefix, multimodal and encoder cache reset
mechanisms.trigger: the reset_* calls, and pause or sleep with clear_cache
mechanisms.observable: the scheduler and worker caches clear on every engine; a request in flight logs a desync warning

mechanisms.name: Multimodal P0/P1 cache drift recovery
mechanisms.trigger: the engine receiver cache missing a hash the frontend omitted
mechanisms.observable: the request ends with ERROR and mm_cache_miss_hashes, the frontend drops those hashes from its sender cache, and a client retry resends the data
mechanisms.note: the invalidation half is modeled; the input thread treats a miss as a generic error, so hashes are never sent back

mechanisms.name: Streaming input sessions
mechanisms.trigger: generate given an async generator of StreamingInput
mechanisms.observable: each chunk adds to one request; a chunk arriving mid-output queues until the previous finishes, and a final empty request closes the session
mechanisms.note: the input side and scheduler run; the output processor chunk queue and apply_streaming_update do not

mechanisms.name: Multimodal tensor IPC over a shared queue
mechanisms.trigger: msgpack encoding of a large tensor with mm_tensor_ipc torch_shm
mechanisms.observable: the tensor moves through shared memory on a torch queue with a handle in the message; the receiver drains and buffers by sender and message, and a send failure falls back to inline
mechanisms.note: tensor-ipc hits in the model are only config flags

mechanisms.name: Msgpack zero-copy serialization
mechanisms.trigger: every ZMQ message between client and engine
mechanisms.observable: tensors over VLLM_MSGPACK_ZERO_COPY_THRESHOLD travel as side frames rather than copies; pickle extensions work only with VLLM_ALLOW_INSECURE_SERIALIZATION
mechanisms.note: the insecure gate and hooks are modeled; the size threshold and aux buffers are not

mechanisms.name: LLMEngine synchronous step path
mechanisms.trigger: LLMEngine.step, called by offline LLM.generate
mechanisms.observable: one call blocks for outputs (or steps in-process under InprocClient), returns RequestOutputs, aborts stop-string finishes, records stats, and logs at most each VLLM_LOG_STATS_INTERVAL

mechanisms.name: Prometheus engine metrics family
mechanisms.trigger: each output-handler pass and LLMEngine step, fed by SchedulerStats and IterationStats
mechanisms.observable: vllm:* gauges, counters and histograms per engine for running, waiting, KV usage, tokens, TTFT, ITL, E2E, cache hits and finish reasons

mechanisms.name: Periodic stats log line
mechanisms.trigger: do_log_stats on the VLLM_LOG_STATS_INTERVAL timer
mechanisms.observable: an INFO line (DEBUG when idle) reports prompt and generation throughput, running, waiting, KV usage, and cache hit rates
mechanisms.note: record accumulates, but stat-logger-manager.log only stamps a time: no throughput, reset or line is computed

mechanisms.name: Cache hit, spec decode and LoRA stats calculators
mechanisms.trigger: SchedulerStats and step outputs reaching a logger
mechanisms.observable: hit rates over the most recent 1000 requests, draft acceptance histograms, and per-adapter waiting and running sets
mechanisms.note: each has its own logic but no caller in the model: no pipeline feeds them

mechanisms.name: Model performance metrics (flops and bytes)
mechanisms.trigger: each scheduler update when perf stats are enabled
mechanisms.observable: per-GPU flops and read and write bytes are computed from the config and the step shape, then logged and exported to Prometheus
mechanisms.note: only the attention breakdown exists, with no caller; ModelMetrics, the FFN and unembed metrics and the export are missing

mechanisms.name: In-process metrics snapshot
mechanisms.trigger: LLMEngine.get_metrics
mechanisms.observable: the registry is read and vllm:* metrics return as Counter, Gauge, Histogram and Vector values

mechanisms.name: Multiprocess and Ray Prometheus backends
mechanisms.trigger: more than one API server, or RayPrometheusStatLogger in use
mechanisms.observable: a temporary PROMETHEUS_MULTIPROC_DIR aggregates across processes, each marked dead at shutdown; the Ray logger exports through Ray metrics with sanitized names
mechanisms.note: the multiprocess directory is modeled; the Ray stat logger is only its name sanitizer

mechanisms.name: Per-iteration details capture
mechanisms.trigger: each step with enable_logging_iteration_details
mechanisms.observable: each iteration records context and generation requests, tokens, encoder inputs and elapsed ms, attaches them to SchedulerStats, and logs them

mechanisms.name: Multi-process supervision and API server launch
mechanisms.trigger: vllm serve with --api-server-count, or a Rust frontend
mechanisms.observable: API servers spawn on shared listeners; wait_for_completion_or_failure blocks on all sentinels and raises when any process dies with non-zero status or an engine fails
mechanisms.note: spawn is modeled, but the supervision wait is only a return value and RustFrontendProcessManager is missing

mechanisms.name: Engine profiling session
mechanisms.trigger: start_profile and stop_profile
mechanisms.observable: one session at a time on a single API server, validated bounds, engine and frontend profilers run together, a failed start clears the session

mechanisms.name: KV connector wiring at engine init
mechanisms.trigger: EngineCore.__init__ with a scheduler connector configured
mechanisms.observable: the executor builds output aggregators, worker handshake metadata merges into the scheduler connector, and a rejected transfer submits a pre-aborted request to free resources
mechanisms.note: abort_immediately is modeled; engine init never calls the aggregator setup or the metadata merge

mechanisms.name: OpenTelemetry request spans
mechanisms.trigger: a finished request with an OTLP endpoint configured
mechanisms.observable: an llm_request span with timing and usage attributes is exported, linked to the trace headers

mechanisms.name: Engine exception dump
mechanisms.trigger: an exception from execute_model inside log_error_detail
mechanisms.observable: the config, scheduler output and stats are logged before the exception continues

mechanisms.name: DP GPU shard and network device assignment
mechanisms.trigger: engine and worker process start under DP or with VLLM_GPU_NIC_PCIE_MAPPING
mechanisms.observable: each DP rank gets its slice of physical GPUs (an IndexError is reported when out of range), and workers select the NIC mapped to their GPU

mechanisms.name: Usage statistics report
mechanisms.trigger: worker init, when usage stats are enabled
mechanisms.observable: one record with the architecture, parallelism and attention backend goes to the usage reporter

mechanisms.name: Startup heap freeze for GC
mechanisms.trigger: the end of EngineCore init, and shutdown
mechanisms.observable: startup objects leave GC scans to shorten pauses; shutdown unfreezes so an engine deleted in-process frees GPU memory
